referee_caveats_inferred: The stack constrains a weighted population average; it does not establish a <10^6 M⊙ limit for every object.
A brightness-, color-, and MIRI-selected sample need not represent all LRDs.
The quoted stacked 3σ limit of 10.8 μJy requires an explicit upper-limit convention alongside the measured 2.1±2.9 μJy.
The dust-temperature descriptions differ in precision: ~114 K in the derivation and ~100 K in the Summary.
Single-band non-detections cannot distinguish compact modest dust from dense-gas reddening.
The supplied text does not identify the provenance of the average and predicted SED explicitly enough to assign it confidently to a cited work.
